.github/workflows/catalogue_asus.yml:
name: 固件采集 · ASUS
run-name: ASUS · 增量更新 · 第 ${{ inputs.batch || '1' }} 批
'on':
  schedule:
  - cron: 5 */6 * * *
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      operation:
        description: 增量续跑 / 重试失败项 / 重新核对来源
        type: choice
        options:
        - incremental
        - retry_failed
        - refresh_sources
        default: incremental
      mode:
        description: 兼容旧入口；采集仅暂存，由每10分钟统一发布
        type: choice
        options:
        - audit
        - publish
        default: audit
      cycle:
        description: 兼容旧续跑参数，手动留空
        default: ''
      batch:
        description: 自动续跑批次
        default: '1'
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: write
concurrency:
  group: catalogue-v2-asus
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  catalogue:
    name: 采集、复用缓存、加密保存断点（不访问D1）
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(vars.FMR_CATALOGUE_RUNNER || '["self-hosted","findmyrom-metadata"]') }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    environment: production
    env:
      GH_WORKFLOW_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      FMR_CATALOGUE_LOCAL_STATE: 'true'
      FMR_CATALOGUE_STATE_DIR: ${{ vars.FMR_CATALOGUE_STATE_DIR || '/var/lib/findmyrom/catalogue-v3' }}
      SIGN_PRIVATE_KEY_HEX: ${{ secrets.SIGN_PRIVATE_KEY_HEX }}
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
        path: catalogue-code
    - name: Prepare isolated Python environment
      shell: bash
      run: |
        python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/fmr-python"
        printf '%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP/fmr-python/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
    - run: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
    - name: 清理过期与超预算页面缓存，保留完整采集断点
      run: python -u -m fmr_ingest_stock.staged_catalogue maintain-cache --vendor asus
    - name: 接续检查点采集（每30秒心跳，D1零请求）
      id: collect
      continue-on-error: true
      env:
        CATALOGUE_OPERATION: ${{ inputs.operation || 'incremental' }}
      run: python -u -m fmr_ingest_stock.staged_catalogue collect --vendor asus --operation "$CATALOGUE_OPERATION"
    - name: 校验备份由本次任务生成且内容完整
      id: export_check
      if: always() && (steps.collect.outcome == 'success' || steps.collect.outcome == 'failure')
      run: python -u -m fmr_ingest_stock.staged_catalogue verify-export --scope asus
    - name: 持久保存加密进度；断开后可续接
      if: always() && steps.export_check.outcome == 'success'
      id: snapshot
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: catalogue-v3-asus
        path: ${{ env.FMR_CATALOGUE_STATE_DIR }}/upload/asus.sqlite.enc
        if-no-files-found: error
        retention-days: 90
        compression-level: 0
    - name: 仅保留最近三份加密快照
      if: steps.snapshot.outcome == 'success'
      run: python -m fmr_ingest_stock.staged_catalogue prune --vendor asus
    - name: 有积压就自动接下一批
      if: steps.snapshot.outcome == 'success' && steps.collect.outcome == 'success'
      run: python -m fmr_ingest_stock.staged_catalogue next --vendor asus
    - name: 报告本批中断
      if: steps.collect.outcome == 'failure'
      run: exit 1
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: catalogue-code

    name: 按需下载并打包成一个 ZIP（不提取镜像）
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120
    environment: production
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
    - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:

    - run: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
    - name: 有请求才构建，成品为单个完整 ZIP
      env:

        CF_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CF_API_TOKEN }}
        CF_D1_DATABASE_ID: ${{ secrets.CF_D1_DATABASE_ID }}

      == '43 */6 * * *'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    environment: production
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        path: runner
        persist-credentials: false
    - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: '3.12'
    - run: python -m pip install -r runner/requirements.txt
    - name: Generate public Markdown only
      working-directory: runner
      env:
        CF_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CF_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        CF_D1_DATABASE_ID: ${{ secrets.CF_D1_DATABASE_ID }}
        CF_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CF_API_TOKEN }}
        PUBLIC_SITE_URL: https://findmyrom.com
      run: python -m fmr_extractor.jumper_sync --output-dir ../projection
    - name: Check out public index with its dedicated write key
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        repository: TunJinshou050608/android-boot-images-index
        path: public-index
        ssh-key: ${{ secrets.GH_JUMPER_SSH_KEY }}
        persist-credentials: true
    - name: Publish changed Markdown
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        cp projection/README.md public-index/README.md
        mkdir -p projection/devices
        mkdir -p public-index/devices
        rsync -a --delete projection/devices/ public-index/devices/
        cd public-index
        git add -- README.md devices
        if git diff --cached --quiet; then
          echo 'Public index is unchanged.' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          exit 0
        fi
        git -c user.name=FindMyROM -c user.email=automation@findmyrom.com commit -m 'Update firmware and boot image index'
        git push origin HEAD:main
        echo 'Published public Markdown; all downloads return to findmyrom.com.' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
    concurrency:
      group: public-jumper-index
      cancel-in-progress: false
  check:
    runs-on:
    - self-hosted
    - Linux
    - X64
    - findmyrom-metadata
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Test service and HTTP delivery without downloading firmware
      run: |
        python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/fmr-service-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
        "$RUNNER_TEMP/fmr-service-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}/bin/python" -m pip install -r requirements.txt
        "$RUNNER_TEMP/fmr-service-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}/bin/python" -m pytest -q tests/test_extractor_service.py tests/test_streaming_probe.py
    - name: Check deployed website without downloading images
      run: |
        curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 30 https://findmyrom.com/ --output /dev/null
        status=$(curl --silent --show-error --max-time 30 https://findmyrom.com/api/extract --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}')
        test "$status" = 403
        printf 'Gateway rejects unsigned extraction requests: HTTP %s\n' "$status"
    - name: Clean isolated environment
      if: always()
      run: rm -rf -- "$RUNNER_TEMP/fmr-service-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && ((github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.service == 'check'))
    concurrency:
      group: extractor-service-check
      cancel-in-progress: false

      FMR_CATALOGUE_STATE_DIR: ${{ vars.FMR_CATALOGUE_STATE_DIR || '/var/lib/findmyrom/catalogue-v3' }}

        working-directory: tg-code-${{ github.run_id }}

    - name: Start next local collector session

      run: gh workflow run telegram_fetch.yml --ref main
